• Hintergrund in Deep Learning und Reinforcement Learning, einschließlich praktischer Erfahrungen mit der Anwendung dieser Methoden auf LLMs und Stiftungsmodelle.
• Demonstrierte Branchenerfahrung mit ML-basierten Produktfunktionen in großem Maßstab.
• Bewährte Erfolge bei der Gestaltung, Schulung und Optimierung von LLMs und / oder multimodalen Fundamentmodellen in großem Maßstab.
• Verständnis auf Expertenebene für Theorie und Praxis des maschinellen Lernens mit Spezialisierung auf generative Modellierung und groß angelegte Architekturen.
• Forschung oder angewandte Erfahrung in Entscheidungsfindung, Reinforcement Learning und Agentic Reasoning.
• Starke Forschungsbilanz mit Peer-Review-Publikationen an führenden AI / ML- oder NLP-Standorten (z. B. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL).

Bei Apple sind wir nicht alle gleich. Und das ist unsere größte Stärke. Wir stützen uns auf die Unterschiede darin, wer wir sind, was wir erlebt haben und wie wir denken. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Résumé
Prêt à transformer comment des milliards de personnes interagissent avec la technologie? L'équipe d'Apple Core Foundation Models pilote l'intelligence qui alimente des milliards d'appareils à travers le monde, et nous cherchons un talent exceptionnel pour nous rejoindre! Rejoignez notre équipe de ML appliquée basée en Europe alors que nous construisons la prochaine génération de modèles de fondation d'Apple, repoussant les limites des capacités d'agents pour permettre de nouveaux produits et expériences pour nos clients.

En tant que membre principal de l'équipe, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des chercheurs et des ingénieurs en systèmes pour faire progresser nos modèles de base sur les capacités essentielles aux produits Apple Intelligence. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes à travers les hubs d'ingénierie d'Apple – y compris New York, Seattle et Cupertino – pour repousser la frontière des capacités d'agents comme le codage, l'ingénierie logicielle, l'utilisation des appareils, la compréhension et la navigation ui, la recherche d'agents, et plus encore. Si vous prospèrez à l'intersection de l'apprentissage du renforcement, du raisonnement et de l'IA agentique — et que vous aimez transformer la recherche en produits utilisés par des milliards — c'est le rôle qui vous incombe.

Désignation des marchandises
En tant que membre principal de notre équipe d'IA, vous dirigerez le progrès transformateur dans les modèles linguistiques à grande échelle avec un accent fort sur le renforcement de l'apprentissage. Votre mission est de repousser les limites de la planification, du raisonnement et de l'intelligence agentique en développant et en appliquant des techniques RL pour former et affiner des modèles de fondation de nouvelle génération. Vous travaillerez sur l'ensemble du pipeline de développement de l'IA – de la conception d'architectures multimodales à l'avancement de la prise de décision, de l'évaluation et du déploiement à grande échelle à des milliards d'appareils dans le monde entier.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader technique pionnier ayant fait ses preuves dans la construction et la mise à l'échelle de modèles linguistiques passionnés par l'apprentissage du renforcement pour débloquer de nouveaux niveaux de raisonnement, d'adaptabilité et d'autonomie en AI.

Qualités minimales

• Expérience de l'industrie dans le développement, la formation et le déploiement de systèmes ML à grande échelle, en mettant l'accent sur l'optimisation des performances des modèles.
• Expérience de l'industrie démontrée sur le développement de capacités d'agents pour les modèles de fondation modernes.

Qualifications privilégiées
• Maîtrise du Python et des cadres ML modernes (PyTorch/JAX).
• Capacité éprouvée d'analyser les données, de diagnostiquer les goulets d'étranglement et d'optimiser les modèles à grande échelle pour la performance et l'efficacité, avec créativité dans la résolution de défis techniques complexes.
• Forte capacité de réflexion critique, de collaboration et de communication, avec la capacité de transmettre des concepts complexes aux intervenants techniques et non techniques.
• Contexte de l'apprentissage profond et du renforcement de l'apprentissage, y compris l'expérience pratique de l'application de ces méthodes aux LLM et aux modèles de fondation.
• Expérience de l'industrie démontrée en fournissant à l'échelle des caractéristiques de produit pilotées par ML.
• Expérience éprouvée dans la conception, la formation et l'optimisation des LLM et/ou des modèles de fondation multimodaux à l'échelle.

jobs.description:
Summary
As part of Siri Attention and Invocation, we collaborate to deliver the next revolution in human-computer interaction, to inspire and create groundbreaking technology for large-scale systems spanning speech, vision, and generative AI to overcome real-world challenges through innovation and user-centered design that improves the daily experience of millions of our customers.

Description
We are seeking an exceptional Staff Machine Learning Engineer to lead the development of audio and video generation capabilities. In this role, you will drive the technical vision for generating realistic, expressive synthetic speech and visual representations, mentor senior and junior engineers, and shape the roadmap for multimodal generative experiences across our products.

Minimum Qualifications
• Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
• Deep hands-on experience with generative audio and/or video architectures (e.g., diffusion models, autoregressive models, GANs, VAEs, end-to-end neural synthesis)
• Demonstrated ability to lead complex, ambiguous projects from research through production, and to make sound technical tradeoffs under real-world constraints (quality, latency, compute)
• Experience evaluating generative model outputs, including both objective metrics and perceptual/subjective quality assessment

Preferred Qualifications
• Proven experience building and shipping machine learning systems in production, with significant focus on generative modeling
• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of working across research, engineering, and product teams
• Strong software engineering skills, with experience designing scalable ML systems and pipelines (e.g., Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, distributed training infrastructure)
• Experience with speech synthesis (TTS), voice conversion, audio acoustics/background modeling, or conversational AI systems
• Experience with generative video/animation techniques (e.g., facial animation, lip-sync, avatar rendering, video diffusion)
• Publications in generative modeling, speech, audio, or computer vision at top-tier venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICASSP, CVPR, Interspeech)
• Experience deploying real-time or low-latency generative models at scale
• Familiarity with multimodal modeling (joint audio-visual generation, cross-modal conditioning)
• Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading technical direction for a team

At Apple, we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced, and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sintesi
Nell'ambito dell'attenzione e dell'invocazione di Siri, collaboriamo per offrire la prossima rivoluzione nell'interazione uomo-computer, per ispirare e creare tecnologie innovative per sistemi su larga scala che spaziano dal discorso, dalla visione e dall'intelligenza artificiale generativa per superare le sfide del mondo reale attraverso l'innovazione e il design incentrato sull'utente che migliora l'esperienza quotidiana di milioni di nostri clienti.

Designazione
Stiamo cercando un eccezionale Staff Machine Learning Engineer per condurre lo sviluppo di capacità di generazione audio e video. In questo ruolo, si guida la visione tecnica per generare realistico, espressivo discorso sintetico e rappresentazioni visive, mentore senior e junior ingegneri, e modellare la roadmap per le esperienze generative multimodali attraverso i nostri prodotti.

Qualifiche minime
• Master o PhD in Informatica, Ingegneria Elettrica, Machine Learning, o un campo correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente
• Esperienza pratica profonda con architetture audio generative e/o video (ad esempio, modelli di diffusione, modelli autoregressivi, GAN, VAEs, sintesi neurale end-to-end)
• Dimostrata capacità di condurre progetti complessi e ambigui dalla ricerca attraverso la produzione, e di fare compromessi tecnici sonori sotto vincoli reali (qualità, latenza, calcolo)
• Valutare le uscite dei modelli generativi, comprese le metriche obiettive e la valutazione della qualità percettiva/soggettiva

Preferiti
• Prove esperienze costruzione e sistemi di apprendimento della macchina di trasporto in produzione, con un focus significativo sulla modellazione generativa
• Eccellente capacità di collaborazione e comunicazione, con un track record di lavoro tra ricerca, ingegneria e team di prodotti
• Forte capacità di ingegneria del software, con esperienza nella progettazione di sistemi e tubazioni ML scalabili (ad esempio, Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, infrastruttura di formazione distribuita)
• Esperienza con sintesi vocale (TTS), conversione vocale, modellazione audio/background, o sistemi AI conversazione
• Esperienza con tecniche generative di video/animazione (ad esempio, animazione facciale, lip-sync, rendering avatar, diffusione video)
• Pubblicazioni per la modellazione generativa, il discorso, l'audio o la visione del computer in luoghi di alto livello (ad esempio, NeurIPS, ICML, ICASSP, CVPR, Interspeech)
• Esperienza nella distribuzione di modelli generativi in tempo reale o a bassa latenza su scala
• Familiarità con modellazione multimodale (generazione audiovisiva congiunta, condizionamento cross-modal)
• Ingegneri di mentoring esperienza precedente o direzione tecnica leader per un team

A Apple, non siamo tutti uguali. E questa e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Disegniamo le differenze di chi siamo, di ciò che abbiamo sperimentato e di come pensiamo. Perché per creare prodotti che servono tutti, crediamo in inclusi tutti. Pertanto, ci impegniamo a trattare tutti i candidati in modo equo ed equo. Collaboreremo con i candidati per fare qualsiasi alloggio ragionevole.

A Apple, crediamo che l'accessibilità sia un diritto umano fondamentale. Troverete che l'idea riflessa in tutto qui — nella nostra cultura, i nostri benefici e i nostri strumenti digitali. Accogliendo quante più prospettive possibile, vi aiutiamo a costruire una carriera in cui vi sentite come voi appartenete.

Scopri l’accessibilità sul posto di lavoro di Apple

jobs.description:
Summary
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. We are a group of engineers and researchers building multimodal foundation models at Apple, with a particular focus on image understanding and generation. We build infrastructure, datasets, and models with fundamental general capabilities and work with a cross-functional partners to apply these models to ship features to millions of users. We are looking for researchers who are passionate about developing algorithms, techniques, and systems that push the frontier of deep learning and delight millions of users with Apple products powered by foundation models.

Description
We believe that the most interesting problems in deep learning research arise when we try to apply learning to real-world use cases, and this is also where the most important breakthroughs come from. You will work with a close-knit and fast-growing team of world-class engineers and scientists to tackle some of the most challenging problems in foundation models and deep learning, including natural language processing, multi-modal understanding, and combining learning with knowledge. You will have opportunities to identify and develop novel applications of deep learning in Apple products. You will see your ideas not only published in papers, and also improve the experience of millions of users.

Minimum Qualifications
• Demonstrated expertise in deep learning with a publication record in relevant conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, KDD, ACL)
• Deep understanding of multi-task, multi-modal machine learning domain
• Proficient programming skills in Python and one of the deep learning toolkits such as JAX, PyTorch, or Tensorflow
• PhD, or equivalent practical experience, in Computer Science, or related technical field

Preferred Qualifications
• A track record in applying deep learning techniques to shipping products
• Multi-modal perception for existing products and future hardware platforms

Beschreibung
Wir glauben, dass die interessantesten Probleme in der Deep-Learning-Forschung entstehen, wenn wir versuchen, das Lernen auf reale Anwendungsfälle anzuwenden, und hier kommen auch die wichtigsten Durchbrüche. Sie werden mit einem engmaschigen und schnell wachsenden Team von Weltklasse-Ingenieuren und Wissenschaftlern zusammenarbeiten, um einige der schwierigsten Probleme in Grundlagenmodellen und Deep Learning anzugehen, einschließlich natürlicher Sprachverarbeitung, multimodalem Verständnis und der Kombination von Lernen mit Wissen. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, neue Anwendungen von Deep Learning in Apple-Produkten zu identifizieren und zu entwickeln. Sie werden Ihre Ideen nicht nur in Papieren veröffentlicht sehen und auch die Erfahrung von Millionen von Benutzern verbessern.

• Tiefes Verständnis der Multi-Task-, multimodalen Machine Learning-Domain
• Erfahrene Programmierkenntnisse in Python und einem der Deep Learning Toolkits wie JAX, PyTorch oder Tensorflow
• PhD oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung, in der Informatik oder verwandten technischen Bereich

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• Multimodale Wahrnehmung für bestehende Produkte und zukünftige Hardwareplattformen
• On-Device Intelligence und Lernen mit starkem Datenschutz
• Fähigkeit, Ideen / Lösungen schnell zu prototypisieren, kritische Analysen durchzuführen und kreative Ansätze zur Lösung komplexer Probleme zu verwenden.
• Fähigkeit, eng mit global verteilten Teams zusammenzuarbeiten.

jobs.description:

The people here at Apple donʼt just build products - they craft the kind of wonder thatʼs
revolutionised entire industries. Itʼs the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the
innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading
environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.
Appleʼs Sales organisation generates the revenue needed to fuel our ongoing development of
products and services. This in turn, enriches the lives of hundreds of millions of people around
the world. Our sales team, in many ways, is the face of Apple to our largest customers. In this role, you will be in a key position to fully take advantage of our products and the huge interest for Apple in the local market to drive our sales to the next level.

We are looking for a Channel Communications Manager based in Zurich, reporting to the Channel Communications Leader DACH. You will manage channel communications for Retail partners, Apple Premium Resellers (Apple Monobrand) and distributors in Switzerland — putting you in a key position to drive sales growth through impactful partner marketing.

Sitting within Appleʼs Channel Sales organisation, this is a highly collaborative and visible role. You will work across country teams, partners and Apple’s European organisation, building a broad network at many levels. It requires proven marketing expertise, demonstrated commercial mindset and the ability to negotiate effectively with stakeholders in all organisational levels.

Description
You will manage direct relationships with key partners: consumer electronic retailers, Apple Premium Resellers and distributors in Switzerland. Working closely with sales and central teams, you will plan, execute and evaluate channel marketing activities and establish C-level alignment on long-term and quarterly marketing plans.

Minimum Qualifications
• Min. 6 years of experience in a marketing/advertising agency or in-house marketing communications organisation, with hands-on multi-market campaign delivery and extensive digital marketing experience.
• Proficiency across digital platforms — social, eCRM, content, performance marketing, digital in-store — and media planning, covering the full customer journey.
• Experience in the consumer electronics industry, ideally across the DACH markets.
• Experience in CRM from strategy through execution and performance analysis, including app-based channels and push notification strategies alongside traditional eCRM.
• Strong working knowledge of AI tools and their application in marketing.
• Data-driven with proven analytical skills; proficient in site analytics, campaign analytics and data-informed decision-making.
• Ability to inspire, influence and collaborate across functions and organisational levels.
• Fluent in German and English. French and/or Italian is a benefit.

• BS/BA degree

jobs.title: Vulnerability Researcher, SEAR
jobs.description:
Summary
Apple's Security Engineering & Architecture organization is responsible for the security of all Apple products. Passionate about safeguarding our users, we believe that the best defense requires a great offense. When it comes to securing more than a billion devices running the world's most sophisticated operating systems, that means finding vulnerabilities first. Can you make a difference on this scale? Join our extraordinary team of security researchers and help protect all Apple users.

Description
Our team is dedicated to safeguarding Apple products, encompassing everything from the microarchitecture to applications like Safari, Mail, and Messages. Our responsibilities include evaluating the security of iOS and macOS (kernel and user-land), boot ROMs, firmware, and hardware. By collaborating with a diverse range of teams and vendors, your influence will be felt across Apple’s products, including the iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV. As a team member, your primary role will involve conducting vulnerability research on Apple software, firmware, and hardware components. Analyzing and exploiting vulnerabilities is a crucial aspect of this position. This role demands individuals with robust technical skills and a genuine passion for securing systems by demonstrating their vulnerabilities. If you resonate with these qualities, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Minimum Qualifications
• Proven experience in vulnerability research and binary exploitation
• Excellent understanding of common vulnerability classes and exploitation techniques
• Creative & effective problem-solving and analytical skills
• Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications
• Excellent knowledge of the security architecture of at least one complex operating system.
• Knowledge of macOS/iOS is nice-to-have, but not required.
• Experience with reverse-engineering tools (IDA Pro, Ghidra, etc.) and techniques
• Familiarity with tool development, using programming languages such as C, C++, Python, Swift, Objective-C

At Apple, we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced, and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

• Vertrautheit mit der Werkzeugentwicklung mit Programmiersprachen wie C, C++, Python, Swift, Objective-C

titleByLocale.de: Internship Computer Vision & Machine Learning Forschung

jobs.description:
Summary
We're seeking research interns to create breakthrough innovations in machine learning, computer vision, computer graphics, and related areas. We are particularly interested in 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, neural rendering, view synthesis, and image and video synthesis. You will work directly with an organization of world-class machine learning researchers and engineers. Our work powers cutting-edge technologies across the Apple ecosystem and is published in the most selective scientific journals and conferences.

Description
You are in your final years of a PhD programme in Machine Learning, Statistics, or Computer Vision, and have already published some of your work at top-tier venues in the field. During your time with us, you will continue sharpening your research skills as we go through the various collaborative stages of an ML research project: Identifying a promising research opportunity, reviewing state-of-the-art methods and relevant literature, crafting novel approaches, implementing them as code prototypes, planning and running large-scale experiments across multi-node, multi-GPU systems, writing a paper, and seeing it through to submission.

Topics of interest include but are not limited to 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, neural rendering, view synthesis, and image and video synthesis. You’ll further have the opportunity to collaborate with world-class researchers outside of your immediate internship location. Ultimately, you will work towards publishing new findings arising from the project, either or both as open source code and publications.

Minimum Qualifications
• You are working towards a doctoral degree in computer science, engineering, data science, applied mathematics, or equivalent.
• At the end of the internship, you must return to school to continue your education or the internship must be the last requirement for you to graduate.
• 6 months dedication is preferred, and starting no later than March 2026.
• Solid software engineering skills in complex, multi-language systems. Fluency in Python.
• Experience with PyTorch.
• Proven research expertise in machine learning and/or computer vision.
• Publication record in relevant conferences (e.g., CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, SIGGRAPH, etc).

Preferred Qualifications
• Ability to formulate a research problem, design, experiment, implement and communicate solutions.
• Ability to work in a diverse collaborative environment.
• Strong mathematical skills in linear algebra, probability, optimization and statistics.
• Action oriented.
• Strong overall software development approach. You deliver clean, well-tested code.
• Research experience in 3D reconstruction, neural rendering, view synthesis, image & video synthesis.

jobs.description:
Summary
We're seeking research interns to create breakthrough innovations in machine learning. We are particularly interested in efficiency of frontier models, including LLMs and diffusion models. You will work in an organization of world-class machine learning researchers and engineers. Our work powers cutting-edge technologies across the Apple ecosystem and is published in the most selective scientific journals and conferences.

Description
You are in your final years of a PhD programme in Machine Learning and have already published some of your work at top-tier venues in the field. During your time with us, you will continue sharpening your research skills as we go through the various collaborative stages of an ML research project: Identifying a promising research opportunity, reviewing state-of-the-art methods and relevant literature, crafting novel approaches, implementing them as code prototypes, planning and running large-scale experiments across multi-node, multi-GPU systems, writing a paper, and seeing it through to submission.

Topics of interest include but are not limited to frontier models, efficiency of LLM inference and training, on-device models, speculative decoding, contextual sparsity, quantization and compression. We are a team of best-in-the-world research scientists and engineers with deep experience in computer vision, machine learning, robotics, computer graphics, and related areas. We work on exciting new technologies that bring joy to millions of people.

In our daily work, the team stays innovative, productive, and fun by sharing some key values:

- Passion for the mission: We're here to make something extraordinary. We seek whatever work is right and strive for the best possible results.
- Modesty: The right answer is more significant than being right. We search for solutions as a team and value clear-eyed feedback.
- Lean habits: You can't grow without limits. Time constraints and big goals encourage us to sharpen our focus and learn to make phenomenal decisions.

Minimum Qualifications
• You are working towards a doctoral degree in computer science, engineering, data science, applied mathematics, or equivalent.
• 6 months dedication is preferred, and starting no later than March 2026
• Proven research expertise in machine learning.
• Publication record in relevant conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, COLM, etc).
• Solid software engineering skills in complex, multi-language systems. Fluency in Python.

Preferred Qualifications
• Expertise in ML algorithms and top practices for working with deep learning systems
• Proficiency with ML modeling frameworks (PyTorch, Tensorflow, etc.)
• Strong overall software development approach. You deliver clean, well-tested code.

At Apple, we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced, and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Sei nei tuoi ultimi anni di un programma di dottorato in Machine Learning e hai già pubblicato alcuni dei tuoi lavori nei luoghi più importanti del settore. Durante il vostro tempo con noi, continuerete ad affinare le vostre capacità di ricerca mentre passiamo attraverso le varie fasi collaborative di un progetto di ricerca ML: Identificare una promettente opportunità di ricerca, rivedere i metodi all'avanguardia e la letteratura rilevante, creare approcci nuovi, implementandoli come prototipi di codice, pianificare e eseguire esperimenti su larga scala attraverso sistemi multi-nodo, multi-GPU, scrivere un giornale e vederlo attraverso la presentazione.

Siamo un team di migliori scienziati e ingegneri di ricerca nel mondo con profonda esperienza nella visione del computer, nell'apprendimento automatico, nella robotica, nella grafica informatica e nelle aree correlate. Lavoriamo su nuove tecnologie emozionanti che portano gioia a milioni di persone.

Nel nostro lavoro quotidiano, il team rimane innovativo, produttivo e divertente condividendo alcuni valori chiave:

- Passione per la missione: Siamo qui per rendere qualcosa di straordinario. Cerchiamo qualsiasi lavoro è giusto e ci sforziamo per i migliori risultati possibili.
- Modesty: La risposta giusta è più significativa di essere giusta. Cerchiamo soluzioni come team e feedback chiari.
- Abiti lievi: Non puoi crescere senza limiti. I vincoli di tempo e i grandi obiettivi ci incoraggiano ad affinare la nostra attenzione e imparare a prendere decisioni fenomenali.

Qualifiche minime
• Stai lavorando verso una laurea in informatica, ingegneria, scienza dei dati, matematica applicata o equivalente.
• 6 mesi di dedizione è preferito, e a partire non più tardi di marzo 2026
• Prove competenze di ricerca nel machine learning.
• Documento di pubblicazione in conferenze pertinenti (ad esempio, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, COLM, ecc).
• Competenze di ingegneria del software solido in sistemi complessi e multilingua. Fluenza in Python.

Qualificazioni predestinate
• Competenza negli algoritmi ML e nelle migliori pratiche per lavorare con sistemi di apprendimento approfonditi
• Competenza con modelli ML (PyTorch, Tensorflow, ecc.)
• Forte approccio globale di sviluppo del software. Consegni codice pulito e ben testato.

A Apple, non siamo tutti uguali. E questa e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Disegniamo le differenze di chi siamo, di ciò che abbiamo sperimentato e di come pensiamo. Perché per creare prodotti che servono tutti, crediamo in inclusi tutti. Pertanto, ci impegniamo a trattare tutti i candidati in modo equo ed equo. Collaboreremo con i candidati per fare qualsiasi alloggio ragionevole.

A Apple, crediamo che l'accessibilità sia un diritto umano fondamentale. Troverete che l'idea riflessa in tutto qui — nella nostra cultura, i nostri benefici e i nostri strumenti digitali. Accogliendo quante più prospettive possibile, vi aiutiamo a costruire una carriera in cui vi sentite come voi appartenete.

You’ll contribute to the legacy of world-class creative applications like Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, GarageBand, Pixelmator, and Photomator.

We care more about how you think than which platform you’ve been thinking on. If you’re a senior engineer from a graphics, systems, media, or ML background who is excited to go deep on Apple platforms — and you’re the kind of person who obsesses over how a feature feels, not just whether it ships — we want to talk to you.

Description
As a Senior Software Engineer on our team, you will drive the architectural design, implementation, and evolution of core features for our next-generation creative applications. We’re looking for a problem-solver who excels in a dynamic environment, capable of both deep technical execution and strategic thinking across complex systems. You should be excited by the prospect of rapidly prototyping innovative concepts while simultaneously establishing robust, forward-looking architectural foundations.

This role is for you if you thrive in a dynamic environment and are equally comfortable with deep technical execution and strategic thinking. You have an instinct for the nuances of photography and the challenges faced by visual creators. You are not just writing code; you are shaping the future of how people capture, edit, and share their most cherished visual memories.

Minimum Qualifications
• 6+ years of professional experience building and shipping production software
• Demonstrated mastery of software architecture patterns, data structures, and algorithms, especially in high-performance contexts
• Deep proficiency in at least one modern systems or application language (Swift, C++, Rust, Objective-C, Kotlin, Java, or similar), and a track record of picking up new platforms and languages quickly
• Strong product sense: a history of shipping features where you owned the user experience, not just the implementation
• Track record of effective cross-functional collaboration with design, product, and partner engineering teams

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Apple’s core frameworks — UIKit, SwiftUI, Core Animation, AVFoundation, Core Image, and Metal (or equivalent graphics frameworks on other platforms)
• Experience integrating machine learning into shipping products — on-device inference, model performance and memory trade-offs, or building product experiences around probabilistic model output
• Fluency with AI-assisted development tools and an interest in helping the team use them well
• Extensive experience identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks in client applications, with a focus on UI responsiveness, memory management, power efficiency, and real-time processing
• Experience developing applications that involve complex media manipulation, rendering, or content creation workflows for professionals or enthusiasts (e.g., video editing, music production, graphic design, or advanced image processing)
• Demonstrated ability to technically lead projects, mentor engineers, and drive cross-functional initiatives from concept to delivery in a fast-paced environment

At Apple, we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced, and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

jobs.title: CH-Technical Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Summary
Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only-at-Apple experience. At Apple, we believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

As a Technical Specialist, you offer technical support and skilled troubleshooting for all customers while also generating excitement for Apple’s products and services. You deliver exceptional service and empower customers to get the most out of their Apple products.

A Technical Specialist also makes sure customers are educated about repair options and Apple products and services.

Description
Develop knowledge and stay up to date on Apple products, services, and Genius Bar repair processes to support efficient and high-quality repairs.

Support customers having Apple product or software issues with care and empathy, using all tools and resources provided by Apple.

Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve service concerns for select Apple hardware and software.

Work with team leaders to identify recurring repair problems and other service concerns, and make sure that feedback is provided to Apple.

Provide excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting product and service recommendations, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy.

Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to supporting customer-facing activities on or off the sales floor.

Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other’s differences and having the curiosity to learn.

Demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.

Minimum Qualifications
• You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends, and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.
• You should also be proficient in the local language, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications
• You can:
• Demonstrate technical expertise of Apple products and services.
• Follow troubleshooting steps to identify the root cause of a technical issue in a customer service environment.
• Navigate customer service issues with care and strong interpersonal skills.
• Consistently learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services and third party products to enhance the customer experience.
• Work in a fast-paced environment and balance multiple tasks at the same time.
• Work well in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
• Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apple’s core values.
• Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.

At Apple, we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced, and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sintesi
Apple Retail è dove si riunisce il meglio di Apple. Portiamo la nostra esperienza per aiutare le persone a fare ciò che amano, offrendo un'esperienza unica nel suo genere. A Apple, crediamo che l'inclusione sia una responsabilità condivisa e lavoriamo insieme per promuovere una cultura in cui ognuno appartiene e si ispira a fare il loro lavoro migliore.

Come Specialista Tecnico, offriamo supporto tecnico e risoluzione dei problemi abili per tutti i clienti, generando anche emozioni per i prodotti e servizi di Apple. È possibile fornire un servizio eccezionale e consentire ai clienti di ottenere il massimo dai loro prodotti Apple.

Uno specialista tecnico assicura inoltre che i clienti siano istruiti sulle opzioni di riparazione e prodotti e servizi Apple.

Designazione
Sviluppare conoscenze e rimanere aggiornati sui prodotti, servizi e processi di riparazione Genius Bar per supportare riparazioni efficienti e di alta qualità.

Sostenere i clienti che hanno problemi di prodotto o software Apple con cura ed empatia, utilizzando tutti gli strumenti e le risorse forniti da Apple.

Risoluzione dei problemi, diagnosi e risoluzione dei problemi di servizio per selezionare hardware e software Apple.

Lavora con i leader del team per identificare problemi di riparazione ricorrenti e altre preoccupazioni di servizio, e assicurarsi che il feedback è fornito a Apple.

Fornire un servizio eccellente ai clienti Apple cercando di capire le loro esigenze, identificare le opportunità di proprietà, presentare raccomandazioni di prodotto e servizio, e di educare i clienti su modi per acquistare rilevanti.

Eseguire altre attività come necessario, compreso ma non limitato a sostenere le attività di customer-facing su o fuori del piano di vendita.

Contribuisci a un ambiente inclusivo rispettando le differenze e avendo la curiosità di imparare.

Dimostrare i valori di inclusione e diversità di Apple nelle attività quotidiane.

Qualifiche minime
• Si dovrebbe avere disponibilità a lavorare un programma in base alle esigenze aziendali che possono includere notti, fine settimana e festivi nel negozio di vendita al dettaglio, e attendibilmente il lavoro come previsto, in linea con le leggi locali e soggette a qualsiasi alloggio approvato.
• Si dovrebbe anche essere abile nella lingua locale, sia scritta che parlata.

Preferiti
• Potete:
• Dimostrare competenze tecniche di prodotti e servizi Apple.
• Seguire i passaggi di risoluzione dei problemi per identificare la causa principale di un problema tecnico in un ambiente di servizio clienti.
• Navigare problemi di servizio al cliente con cura e forti competenze interpersonali.
• Impara costantemente e approfondisci la tua comprensione di prodotti e servizi Apple e prodotti di terze parti per migliorare l'esperienza del cliente.
• Lavorare in un ambiente frenetico e bilanciare più attività contemporaneamente.
• Lavorare bene in un ambiente di squadra, dimostrando responsabilità condivisa e responsabilità con altri membri del team.
• Sii affidabile con informazioni sensibili o riservate, mantenendo i valori fondamentali di Apple.
• Sii curioso e aperto ad imparare dagli altri e ad aiutarsi a crescere.

A Apple, non siamo tutti uguali. E questa e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Disegniamo le differenze di chi siamo, di ciò che abbiamo sperimentato e di come pensiamo. Perché per creare prodotti che servono tutti, crediamo in inclusi tutti. Pertanto, ci impegniamo a trattare tutti i candidati in modo equo ed equo. Collaboreremo con i candidati per fare qualsiasi alloggio ragionevole.

A Apple, crediamo che l'accessibilità sia un diritto umano fondamentale. Troverete che l'idea riflessa in tutto qui — nella nostra cultura, i nostri benefici e i nostri strumenti digitali. Accogliendo quante più prospettive possibile, vi aiutiamo a costruire una carriera in cui vi sentite come voi appartenete.

Scopri l’accessibilità sul posto di lavoro di Apple

descriptionByLocale.de:
Zusammenfassung
Apple Retail ist der Ort, an dem das Beste von Apple zusammenkommt. Wir bringen unser Know-how ein, um Menschen dabei zu helfen, das zu tun, was sie lieben, und bieten ein Only-at-Apple-Erlebnis. Bei Apple glauben wir, dass Inklusion eine gemeinsame Verantwortung ist, und wir arbeiten zusammen, um eine Kultur zu fördern, in der jeder dazugehört und inspiriert wird, seine beste Arbeit zu leisten.

Als technischer Spezialist bieten Sie technischen Support und kompetente Fehlersuche für alle Kunden und erzeugen gleichzeitig Begeisterung für die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Apple. Sie bieten außergewöhnlichen Service und befähigen Kunden, das Beste aus ihren Apple-Produkten herauszuholen.

Ein technischer Spezialist sorgt auch dafür, dass Kunden über Reparaturoptionen und Apple-Produkte und -Services informiert werden.

Beschreibung
Entwickeln Sie Ihr Wissen und halten Sie sich über Apple Produkte, Services und Genius Bar Reparaturprozesse auf dem Laufenden, um effiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Reparaturen zu unterstützen.

Unterstützen Sie Kunden mit Apple Produkt- oder Softwareproblemen mit Sorgfalt und Empathie und verwenden Sie alle von Apple bereitgestellten Tools und Ressourcen.

Behebung, Diagnose und Behebung von Serviceproblemen für ausgewählte Apple-Hardware und -Software.

Arbeiten Sie mit Teamleitern zusammen, um wiederkehrende Reparaturprobleme und andere Serviceprobleme zu identifizieren und sicherzustellen, dass Apple Feedback erhält.

Bieten Sie Apple-Kunden einen hervorragenden Service, indem Sie versuchen, ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen, Besitzmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren, Produkt- und Serviceempfehlungen zu präsentieren und Kunden über relevante Kaufmöglichkeiten aufzuklären.

Führen Sie bei Bedarf andere Aufgaben aus, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf die Unterstützung kundenorientierter Aktivitäten auf oder außerhalb der Verkaufsfläche.

Tragen Sie zu einer integrativen Umgebung bei, indem Sie die Unterschiede des anderen respektieren und die Neugier haben, zu lernen.

Zeigen Sie Apples Werte der Inklusion und Vielfalt in den täglichen Aktivitäten.

Mindestqualifikationen
• Sie sollten verfügbar sein, um einen Zeitplan zu erstellen, der auf Geschäftsanforderungen basiert, die Nächte, Wochenenden und Feiertage im Einzelhandelsgeschäft umfassen können, und zuverlässig wie geplant, in Übereinstimmung mit den örtlichen Gesetzen und vorbehaltlich genehmigter Unterkünfte arbeiten.
• Sie sollten auch die lokale Sprache beherrschen, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen
• Sie können:
• Demonstrieren Sie die technische Expertise von Apple Produkten und Dienstleistungen.

jobs.title: CH-Operations Expert (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Summary
Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only-at-Apple experience. We believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

As an Operations Expert, you help drive sales and the customer experience by delivering excellence in operations, inventory accuracy, and preservation activities. You have a deep understanding of operational practices and mentor the Operations team to complete operational tasks accurately and in accordance with Retail Inventory processes.

Description
Complete inventory receiving, counting, returning, and shipping tasks in compliance with Retail Inventory processes, and mentor and support team members in doing so.

Complete product fulfillment tasks and deliver items from Runner requests to customers and team members in support of creating an exceptional customer experience.

Support Operations Specialists by sharing knowledge about the Retail Inventory processes.

Promote understanding of inventory performance among all store team members and gather inventory data to aid with leadership decision-making.

Monitor all inventory, including non-sellable product, in the inventory management system for accuracy and consistency, and to identify variance trends and understand their root causes.

Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to supporting customer-facing activities.

Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other’s differences and having the curiosity to learn.

Demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.

Minimum Qualifications
• You should:
• Be available to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends, and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.
• Be able to lift and carry product to various locations within and near the store.
• Have experience in retail or sales, or related work experience.
• Be proficient in the local language, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications
• You can:
• Focus on the customer experience, with an emphasis on serving both the internal and external customer.
• Be a self-starter who is detail-oriented, organized, and can work without close supervision.
• Prioritize workload and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
• Demonstrate effective problem solving, analytical, and communication skills.

At Apple, we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced, and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Support Operations Specialists condividendo le conoscenze sui processi di Inventario al dettaglio.

Promuovere la comprensione delle prestazioni di inventario tra tutti i membri del team di negozio e raccogliere i dati di inventario per aiutare con il processo decisionale di leadership.

• Essere in grado di sollevare e trasportare il prodotto in varie località all'interno e vicino al negozio.
• Avere esperienza nella vendita al dettaglio o vendite, o relativa esperienza di lavoro.
• Siate competenti nella lingua locale, sia scritta che parlata.

Qualificazioni predestinate

• Priorizzare il carico di lavoro e rispettare le scadenze in un ambiente frenetico.
• Lavorare in un ambiente di squadra, dimostrando responsabilità e responsabilità condivise con altri membri del team.
• Dimostrare efficaci capacità di problem solving, analitico e di comunicazione.

Sostenere i vostri coetanei in tutto il negozio come necessario condividendo le conoscenze sui prodotti, servizi e opzioni di acquisto di Apple, e assistere a offrire opportunità di proprietà.

Mantenere la precisione e seguire la guida.

Eseguire altre attività come necessario, compreso ma non limitato a fornire il servizio clienti e il supporto in altre aree del negozio.

Contribuisci ad un ambiente inclusivo rispettando le differenze e avendo la curiosità di imparare.

Dimostrare i valori di inclusione e diversità di Apple nelle attività quotidiane.

Qualifiche minime

• Dimostrare la conoscenza dei prodotti e servizi Apple.
• Personalizzare le soluzioni in base alle esigenze del cliente e comunicarle efficacemente.
• Lavorare in un ambiente veloce, spesso supportando più clienti allo stesso tempo.
• Lavorare in un ambiente di squadra, dimostrando responsabilità e responsabilità condivise con altri membri del team.
• Sii curioso e aperto ad imparare dagli altri e ad aiutarsi a crescere.
• Scopri e approfondisci la tua comprensione di prodotti e servizi Apple e prodotti di terze parti, per migliorare l'esperienza del cliente.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Summary
Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only-at-Apple experience. We believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

As a Specialist, you build brand loyalty and create owners of Apple products and services. You’re dedicated to selling and delivering a customer service experience that is unlike any other. A Specialist is curious — you ask questions to learn about our customers’ needs, customizing recommendations to enrich their lives.

Description
Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products.

Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apple’s products, services, purchase options, and Product Zone sales processes.

Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apple’s products, services, and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities.

Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.

Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.

Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other’s differences and having the curiosity to learn.

Demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.

Minimum Qualifications
• You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends, and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.
• You should also be proficient in the local language, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications
• You can:
• Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
• Personalize solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
• Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
• Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
• Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
• Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
• Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apple’s core values.

At Apple, we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced, and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace
descriptionByLocale.de:
Zusammenfassung
Apple Retail ist der Ort, an dem das Beste von Apple zusammenkommt. Wir bringen unser Know-how ein, um Menschen dabei zu helfen, das zu tun, was sie lieben, und bieten ein Only-at-Apple-Erlebnis. Wir glauben, dass Inklusion eine gemeinsame Verantwortung ist und wir arbeiten zusammen, um eine Kultur zu fördern, in der jeder dazugehört und inspiriert wird, seine beste Arbeit zu leisten.

Als Spezialist bauen Sie Markenloyalität auf und erstellen Besitzer von Apple Produkten und Dienstleistungen. Sie widmen sich dem Verkauf und der Bereitstellung eines Kundenservice-Erlebnisses, das anders ist als jedes andere. Ein Spezialist ist neugierig - Sie stellen Fragen, um sich über die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden zu informieren und Empfehlungen anzupassen, um ihr Leben zu bereichern.

Beschreibung
Liefern Sie Apple-Kunden einen hervorragenden Service, indem Sie versuchen, ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen, Besitzmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren, Produkte und Dienstleistungen zu präsentieren und Kunden über relevante Möglichkeiten zum Kauf von Produkten aufzuklären.

Verstehen und bleiben Sie proaktiv auf dem Laufenden über die Produkte, Dienstleistungen, Kaufoptionen und Verkaufsprozesse von Apple.

Unterstützen Sie Ihre Kollegen im gesamten Geschäft nach Bedarf, indem Sie Wissen über die Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Kaufoptionen von Apple teilen und dabei helfen, Besitzmöglichkeiten anzubieten.

Bewahre die Genauigkeit und befolge die Führung.

Führen Sie bei Bedarf andere Aufgaben aus, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf die Bereitstellung von Kundenservice und Support in anderen Bereichen des Geschäfts.

Tragen Sie zu einer integrativen Umgebung bei, indem Sie die Unterschiede des anderen respektieren und die Neugier haben, zu lernen.

Zeigen Sie Apples Werte der Inklusion und Vielfalt in den täglichen Aktivitäten.

Mindestqualifikationen
• Sie sollten verfügbar sein, um einen Zeitplan zu erstellen, der auf Geschäftsanforderungen basiert, die Nächte, Wochenenden und Feiertage im Einzelhandelsgeschäft umfassen können, und zuverlässig die geplante Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit den örtlichen Gesetzen und vorbehaltlich genehmigter Unterkünfte besuchen.
• Sie sollten auch die lokale Sprache beherrschen, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen
• Sie können:
• Demonstrieren Sie Kenntnisse über Apple Produkte und Dienstleistungen.
• Personalisieren Sie Lösungen basierend auf Kundenbedürfnissen und kommunizieren Sie diese effektiv.
• Arbeiten Sie in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung und unterstützen Sie oft mehrere Kunden gleichzeitig.
• Arbeite in einer Teamumgebung und zeige gemeinsame Verantwortung und Rechenschaftspflicht mit anderen Teammitgliedern.
• Sei neugierig und offen dafür, von anderen zu lernen und einander zu helfen, zu wachsen.
• Erfahren Sie mehr über und vertiefen Sie Ihr Verständnis von Apple-Produkten und -Diensten sowie Produkten von Drittanbietern, um das Kundenerlebnis zu verbessern.
• Vertraue sensiblen oder vertraulichen Informationen und halte dabei die Kernwerte von Apple ein.

Bei Apple sind wir nicht alle gleich. Und das ist unsere größte Stärke. Wir beziehen uns auf die Unterschiede darin, wer wir sind, was wir erlebt haben und wie wir denken. Denn um Produkte zu schaffen, die allen dienen, glauben wir daran, alle einzubeziehen. Daher verpflichten wir uns, alle Bewerber fair und gleich zu behandeln. Wir werden mit Bewerbern zusammenarbeiten, um angemessene Unterkünfte zu schaffen.

Bei Apple glauben wir, dass Zugänglichkeit ein grundlegendes Menschenrecht ist. Diese Idee spiegelt sich hier in allem wider - in unserer Kultur, unseren Vorteilen und unseren digitalen Tools. Indem wir so viele Perspektiven wie möglich begrüßen, helfen wir Ihnen, eine Karriere aufzubauen, in der Sie sich wie Sie gehören fühlen.

Erfahren Sie mehr über die Zugänglichkeit am Arbeitsplatz von Apple
descriptionByLocale.fr:

Nous croyons que l'inclusion est une responsabilité partagée et nous travaillons ensemble pour favoriser une culture où tout le monde appartient et est inspiré à faire son meilleur travail.

En tant que spécialiste, vous renforcez la fidélité de la marque et créez des propriétaires de produits et services Apple. Vous êtes dédié à la vente et la fourniture d'une expérience de service à la clientèle qui est différent de toute autre. Un spécialiste est curieux — vous posez des questions pour en apprendre davantage sur nos clients, en personnalisation des recommandations pour enrichir leur vie.

Désignation des marchandises
Offrir un excellent service aux clients Apple en cherchant à comprendre leurs besoins, en identifiant les possibilités de propriété, en présentant des produits et des services et en éduquant les clients sur les moyens pertinents d'acheter des produits.

Comprendre les produits, les services, les options d'achat et les processus de vente de la zone de produits et rester à jour de façon proactive.

Soutenez vos pairs dans tout le magasin au besoin en partageant des connaissances sur les produits, les services et les options d'achat Apple, et aidez à offrir des possibilités de propriété.

Maintenir l'exactitude et suivre les directives.

Effectuer d'autres tâches au besoin, y compris, sans s'y limiter, fournir un service à la clientèle et un soutien dans d'autres secteurs du magasin.

Contribuer à un environnement inclusif en respectant mutuellement les différences et en ayant la curiosité d'apprendre.

Démontrer des valeurs d'inclusion et de diversité dans les activités quotidiennes.

Qualités minimales
• Vous devriez avoir la disponibilité de travailler un horaire basé sur les besoins d'affaires qui peut inclure les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés dans le magasin de détail, et assister de manière fiable au travail comme prévu, conformément aux lois locales et sous réserve de tout hébergement approuvé.
• Vous devriez également être compétent dans la langue locale, à la fois écrite et parlée.

Qualifications privilégiées
• Vous pouvez :
• Démontrer la connaissance des produits et services Apple.
• Personnaliser les solutions en fonction des besoins des clients et les communiquer efficacement.
• Travaillez dans un environnement à rythme rapide, soutenant souvent plusieurs clients en même temps.
• Travailler en équipe, en faisant preuve de responsabilité partagée et de responsabilité avec d'autres membres de l'équipe.
• Soyez curieux et ouvert à l'apprentissage des autres et à l'entraide.
• Découvrez et approfondissez votre compréhension des produits et services Apple, et des produits tiers, pour améliorer l'expérience client.
• Faites confiance à des informations sensibles ou confidentielles, en respectant les valeurs de base d'Apple.

Chez Apple, nous ne sommes pas tous les mêmes. Et c'est notre plus grande force. Nous tirons parti des différences dans notre identité, notre expérience et notre façon de penser. Parce que pour créer des produits qui servent tout le monde, nous croyons en l'inclusion de tous. Par conséquent, nous nous engageons à traiter tous les candidats de façon équitable et équitable. Nous travaillerons avec les demandeurs pour prendre des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables.

Chez Apple, nous croyons que l'accessibilité est un droit humain fondamental. Vous trouverez cette idée reflétée dans tout ici — dans notre culture, nos avantages et nos outils numériques. En accueillant autant de perspectives que possible, nous vous aidons à construire une carrière où vous vous sentez comme à votre place.

jobs.description:
Summary
We are looking for a machine learning research intern with passion to spearhead new solutions to challenging problems in foundation model development with an emphasis on agentic capabilities and Reinforcement Learning. You will closely work with an applied ML team of around 35 engineers in Zurich, and get the chance to connect with other experts in the US.

Description
During your internship, you will do research and development in the context of Apple foundation models that power next-generation AI experiences across Apple’s platforms. You will learn what is relevant to transfer results from machine learning research to meaningful real-world performance at scale. Your work can contribute to Apple Intelligence and be shipped to billions of devices, worldwide.

Minimum Qualifications
• PhD student in Machine Learning (Computer Science, Electrical & Computer Engineering, Statistics, Math, Natural Sciences, or other related fields)
• Strong background in Reinforcement Learning and Deep Learning, with hands-on experience training large models, in particular LLMs
• Experience with training methodologies including pre-training, fine-tuning, and alignment approaches
• Strong programming skills. Most relevant are Python, PyTorch, and JAX

Preferred Qualifications
• Excellent problem solving, critical thinking, and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to define and drive ambitious goal-oriented research and development independently
